notes: DRAFT, hand-edited from the map-808 export after the data census of 2026-10-24 (PREP-HATEFORGE-QUARRY-2026-10-24.md): the packs are the spawn clusters nearest each boss, the row of a pack that the generator had split in two is merged, every radius is 2.5 yd off the group's own spawn rows, and Broody 60715 is Engineer Figgles' first. Not mapped, not live-checked: do the GM-invisible mapping walk and correct the route before the first run; dungeon_run refuses it without allow_draft.
A wait_for on a door a lever or key opens needs timeout_s 60 (the default): a linked door can open 30 s after the use.
Turtle custom. 'Broody' (60715) shares Engineer Figgles' spot and is not a leg.

Bargul 60735 stands on the terrace above the quarry; that terrace is a separate navmesh network (the creature path 2570432 walks up a ramp at -8321.1 -3448.1 z 180.8 / -8323.7 -3452.3 z 182.5 that the mesh does not link to the lower floor). The boss is needs_walk: the mapping walk tests the ramp, else the leg needs a gm_cross or an off-mesh link.
